hero.title: Aurora Grove
hero.tagline: Modern camping website showcasing advanced Bootstrap 4 and SCSS techniques

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.content: Create a visually stunning camping website that showcases modern web design techniques while maintaining excellent performance and accessibility. The site needed to appeal to outdoor enthusiasts while demonstrating advanced Bootstrap customization and responsive design principles.

sections.title: Technical Approach
sections.content: Built using Bootstrap 4 as the foundation, I extended the framework with custom SCSS to create a unique visual identity. Implemented advanced CSS techniques including custom animations, parallax scrolling effects, and a sophisticated grid layout system that adapts beautifully across all devices.

subsections.title: Custom Bootstrap Theme
subsections.content: Created a comprehensive custom theme by overriding Bootstrap variables and adding new utility classes, ensuring consistent branding throughout the site while maintaining Bootstrap's responsive grid system.

subsections.title: Performance Optimization
subsections.content: Optimized all images for web delivery, implemented lazy loading for gallery sections, and minimized CSS/JS bundles to achieve sub-2-second load times on mobile networks.

sections.title: Implementation Details
sections.content: The website features a modular component architecture with reusable SCSS mixins and custom Bootstrap components. Each section was designed to be independently maintainable while contributing to a cohesive user experience.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.content: Aurora Grove successfully demonstrates advanced frontend development skills through its polished design and technical implementation. The site achieves perfect mobile responsiveness scores and maintains fast load times despite rich visual content. It serves as an excellent example of modern Bootstrap customization and responsive web design.
metrics: Cross-browser compatibility with all modern browsers
